name: Type 2 RIP (ricin, abrin)
description: Catalytic A chain plus lectin B chain; depurinates the sarcin/ricin loop of eukaryotic 28S rRNA.

name: Type 1 RIP (PAP, MAP, trichosanthin)
description: Single-domain RIP with no lectin chain; some members also depurinate bacterial 23S rRNA.

name: Shiga toxin (Stx1/Stx2)
description: Bacterial AB5 RIP; A subunit carries the RIP fold, B pentamer binds Gb3.

name: Spiroplasma RIP
description: RIP toxins of Drosophila defensive endosymbionts; depurinate wasp and nematode ribosomes.

name: Culicine RIP (RIPAe1-3)
description: RIP genes in Aedes and Culex genomes, horizontally acquired and under purifying selection.

name: Whitefly ribotoxin/RIP
description: RIP-domain genes in Bemisia and Trialeurodes acquired from plants.

name: Fungal ribotoxin (alpha-sarcin, restrictocin)
description: Secreted RNase T1-family ribonuclease that cleaves one phosphodiester bond in the sarcin/ricin loop.

name: Ageritin
description: Basidiomycete ribotoxin of a fold distinct from the alpha-sarcin family, cleaving the same loop.

name: Hirsutellin A
description: Small insecticidal ribotoxin of entomopathogenic fungi.

name: Colicin E3
description: Cleaves 16S rRNA in the decoding centre of the target ribosome.

name: Colicin E5
description: Cleaves the anticodons of four queuosine-containing tRNAs.

name: Colicin D
description: Cleaves the anticodon loop of tRNA-Arg isoacceptors.

name: CdiA-CT tRNase (colicin D-like/BECR)
description: Polymorphic C-terminal tRNase domains of contact-dependent inhibition systems.

name: SRLase1
description: BECR-like RNase that requires EF-Tu to cleave the 23S sarcin/ricin loop.

name: Ribocin
description: Cleaves helix 69 of eukaryotic large-subunit rRNA.

name: VapC20
description: PIN-domain toxin-antitoxin ribonuclease that cleaves the sarcin/ricin loop of its own 23S rRNA.

name: PrrC anticodon nuclease
description: Latent tRNA-Lys anticodon nuclease held inactive within a type IC restriction-modification complex.

name: RloC
description: Wobble-nucleotide-excising tRNase gated by a Rad50-like DNA-damage sensor.

name: Zymocin gamma-toxin
description: Eukaryal tRNA anticodon nuclease delivered by a chitinase-bearing killer complex.

name: Pichia acaciae toxin (PaOrf2)
description: Anticodon nuclease that excises a dinucleotide to defeat tRNA repair.

name: Diphtheria toxin
description: ADP-ribosylates the diphthamide residue of eEF2.

name: Pseudomonas exotoxin A
description: Diphthamide-specific mART that engages eEF2 by ribosome mimicry.

name: SAIP (Streptomyces antiquus insecticidal protein)
description: Diphtheria-toxin-like exotoxin of Streptomyces that ADP-ribosylates insect eEF2; receptor is the insect protein Flower.

name: T6SS ART Rhs tRNA-Thr toxin
description: Type VI secretion ADP-ribosyltransferase that modifies the anticodon loop of charged tRNA-Thr.

name: Thiostrepton
description: Thiopeptide RiPP binding the 23S rRNA/L11 region of the 50S subunit.

name: Erythromycin
description: Macrolide polyketide binding the nascent peptide exit tunnel of the 50S subunit.

name: Kirromycin
description: Elfamycin-class polyketide locking EF-Tu on the ribosome.

name: Odilorhabdin
description: Cationic non-ribosomal peptide binding the 30S subunit.

name: Alpha-hemolysin (Hla)
description: Heptameric beta-barrel pore-forming toxin of Staphylococcus aureus.

name: Aerolysin-like beta-PFT
description: Beta-pore-forming fold found across bacteria, fungi, plants and animals.

name: Biomphalysin
description: Aerolysin-family pore-forming protein used by a snail against its trematode parasite.

name: Cholesterol-dependent cytolysin
description: Sterol-dependent MACPF/CDC pore former.

name: MACPF perforin-2 (MPEG1)
description: Animal MACPF pore former of the same superfamily as the bacterial CDCs.

name: Bacterial gasdermin
description: Pore-forming antiphage effector; homologous to animal pyroptosis gasdermins.

name: Venom phospholipase A2
description: Secreted PLA2 recruited into snake venom by duplication and neofunctionalisation.

name: Clostridial alpha-toxin (PLC)
description: Zinc metallophospholipase C that hydrolyses membrane phospholipid.

name: Tetrodotoxin
description: Guanidinium alkaloid Nav blocker; bacterial in origin, sequestered by animals.

name: Saxitoxin
description: Alkaloid Nav blocker made by cyanobacteria and dinoflagellates.

name: Bufadienolide
description: Toad steroid glycoside inhibiting the Na+/K+-ATPase.

name: Cardenolide
description: Plant steroid glycoside inhibiting the Na+/K+-ATPase.

name: Conotoxin
description: Disulfide-rich injected peptides of cone snails targeting ion channels and receptors.

name: Batrachotoxin
description: Steroidal alkaloid Nav agonist sequestered by poison frogs from dietary arthropods.

name: Paclitaxel
description: Diterpenoid that stabilises microtubules by binding beta-tubulin.

name: Alpha-amanitin
description: Bicyclic RiPP of Amanita that inhibits RNA polymerase II.

name: Vancomycin
description: Glycopeptide that sequesters the D-Ala-D-Ala terminus of lipid II.

name: Penicillin
description: Fungal beta-lactam that covalently inactivates penicillin-binding proteins.

name: Nisin
description: Lantibiotic RiPP that binds lipid II and also forms pores.

name: Colicin E2
description: Plasmid-encoded DNase colicin neutralised by the Im2 immunity protein.

name: Short prokaryotic Argonaute
description: Nucleic-acid-guided defense effector that triggers an associated NADase.

name: Thoeris (ThsA/ThsB)
description: TIR-domain sensor plus SIR2 NADase; aborts phage infection by NAD+ depletion.

name: SARM1 TIR NADase
description: Animal TIR NADase executing axon degeneration; same chemistry as bacterial TIR defense.

name: Halocin
description: Proteinaceous antimicrobial of haloarchaea active against other haloarchaea.

name: Sulfolobicin
description: Membrane-vesicle-associated proteinaceous toxin of Sulfolobus.

name: Aminoglycoside (kanamycin class)
description: Aminocyclitol antibiotic binding the 16S rRNA decoding site.
